collection.title: Renault Kangoo One Rear Door 2008 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Kangoo 2008 - 2021 model which requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Kangoo, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
